/* =========================================================
   UCCF — Uganda Child Cancer Foundation
   Colors & Type tokens
   ========================================================= */

/* ---------- Fonts ---------- */
@font-face {
  font-family: "Brandon Grotesque";
  src: url("data:font/otf;base64,") format("opentype");
  font-weight: 300;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}
@font-face {
  font-family: "Brandon Grotesque";
  src: url("data:font/otf;base64,") format("opentype");
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}
@font-face {
  font-family: "Brandon Grotesque";
  src: url("data:font/otf;base64,") format("opentype");
  font-weight: 500 700;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}

:root {
  /* ---------- Brand primitives ---------- */
  --uccf-yellow:    #f2d411;  /* sunshine yellow — primary accent */
  --uccf-blue:      #00acea;  /* bright sky blue — primary action */
  --uccf-navy:      #00012b;  /* near-black navy — text & outlines */

  /* Supporting tints (derived, use sparingly) */
  --uccf-yellow-50:  #fff9d1;
  --uccf-yellow-100: #fdeb7a;
  --uccf-yellow-700: #c9ae00;

  --uccf-blue-50:   #e1f6fe;
  --uccf-blue-100:  #b8e9fc;
  --uccf-blue-700:  #0079a6;

  --uccf-navy-80:   #2a2b4d;
  --uccf-navy-60:   #55566f;
  --uccf-navy-40:   #8a8b9a;
  --uccf-navy-20:   #c4c4cc;
  --uccf-navy-10:   #e6e6ea;
  --uccf-navy-05:   #f4f4f6;

  --uccf-white:     #ffffff;
  --uccf-cream:     #fffdf2;   /* warm off-white page bg */

  /* ---------- Semantic colors ---------- */
  --fg-1:           var(--uccf-navy);       /* primary text */
  --fg-2:           var(--uccf-navy-80);    /* secondary text */
  --fg-3:           var(--uccf-navy-60);    /* muted / meta */
  --fg-on-dark:     var(--uccf-white);
  --fg-on-yellow:   var(--uccf-navy);
  --fg-on-blue:     var(--uccf-white);

  --bg-1:           var(--uccf-white);      /* default surface */
  --bg-2:           var(--uccf-cream);      /* warm page bg */
  --bg-3:           var(--uccf-navy-05);    /* subtle panel */
  --bg-dark:        var(--uccf-navy);
  --bg-yellow:      var(--uccf-yellow);
  --bg-blue:        var(--uccf-blue);

  --border-1:       var(--uccf-navy);       /* bold outlines — signature */
  --border-2:       var(--uccf-navy-20);    /* quiet dividers */
  --border-3:       var(--uccf-navy-10);

  --accent:         var(--uccf-yellow);
  --action:         var(--uccf-blue);
  --action-hover:   var(--uccf-blue-700);

  --success:        #2ec27e;
  --warning:        #f2a71b;
  --danger:         #e4572e;
  --info:           var(--uccf-blue);

  /* ---------- Type ---------- */
  --font-sans:  "Brandon Grotesque", "Proxima Nova", "Avenir Next",
                ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto,
                "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-mono:  ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;

  /* Type scale (modular, 1.25) */
  --fs-xs:    12px;
  --fs-sm:    14px;
  --fs-base:  16px;
  --fs-md:    18px;
  --fs-lg:    22px;
  --fs-xl:    28px;
  --fs-2xl:   36px;
  --fs-3xl:   48px;
  --fs-4xl:   64px;
  --fs-5xl:   84px;

  --lh-tight:  1.08;
  --lh-snug:   1.2;
  --lh-normal: 1.45;
  --lh-loose:  1.65;

  --tracking-tight:  -0.01em;
  --tracking-normal: 0;
  --tracking-wide:   0.04em;
  --tracking-xwide:  0.12em;  /* eyebrows / labels */

  /* ---------- Spacing (4px base) ---------- */
  --space-1:  4px;
  --space-2:  8px;
  --space-3:  12px;
  --space-4:  16px;
  --space-5:  20px;
  --space-6:  24px;
  --space-8:  32px;
  --space-10: 40px;
  --space-12: 48px;
  --space-16: 64px;
  --space-20: 80px;
  --space-24: 96px;

  /* ---------- Radii ---------- */
  --radius-xs:  4px;
  --radius-sm:  8px;
  --radius-md:  14px;
  --radius-lg:  22px;    /* default card */
  --radius-xl:  32px;    /* hero / mark-like */
  --radius-pill: 999px;

  /* ---------- Borders (signature: thick navy outlines) ---------- */
  --stroke-1: 1.5px;
  --stroke-2: 2.5px;
  --stroke-3: 4px;       /* hero / logo-adjacent */

  /* ---------- Shadows (soft, low, never fancy) ---------- */
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,1,43,.08);
  --shadow-md: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,1,43,.10);
  --shadow-lg: 0 18px 42px rgba(0,1,43,.14);
  /* Signature "stacked" shadow — a flat navy offset, playful & picture-book */
  --shadow-stack: 6px 6px 0 var(--uccf-navy);

  /* ---------- Motion ---------- */
  --ease-out:   cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
  --ease-in-out:cubic-bezier(.6,0,.4,1);
  --dur-fast:   120ms;
  --dur-base:   220ms;
  --dur-slow:   420ms;
}

/* =========================================================
   Semantic element styles
   ========================================================= */
html, body {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--fg-1);
  background: var(--bg-1);
  font-size: var(--fs-base);
  line-height: var(--lh-normal);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

h1, .h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: var(--fs-4xl);
  line-height: var(--lh-tight);
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-tight);
  color: var(--fg-1);
  margin: 0 0 var(--space-4);
}
h2, .h2 {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: var(--fs-2xl);
  line-height: var(--lh-snug);
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-tight);
  color: var(--fg-1);
  margin: 0 0 var(--space-3);
}
h3, .h3 {
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: var(--fs-xl);
  line-height: var(--lh-snug);
  color: var(--fg-1);
  margin: 0 0 var(--space-3);
}
h4, .h4 {
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: var(--fs-lg);
  line-height: var(--lh-snug);
  color: var(--fg-1);
  margin: 0 0 var(--space-2);
}
p, .p {
  font-size: var(--fs-base);
  line-height: var(--lh-normal);
  color: var(--fg-2);
  margin: 0 0 var(--space-3);
}
small, .small {
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  color: var(--fg-3);
}
.eyebrow {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-xwide);
  color: var(--uccf-blue);
}
.display {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: var(--fs-5xl);
  line-height: .95;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-tight);
}
code, pre, .mono {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: .95em;
}

/* Focus ring — accessible on all surfaces */
:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--uccf-yellow);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
}
